title: Pan-Fried German-Style Pork Belly
description: A traditional German-inspired dish featuring crispy pork belly, served with a side of steamed vegetables.
instructions: Preheat oil in a large skillet to 180°C.
Season the pork belly with Australian peppercorns.
Dip the pork belly in the crushed crisp slices to coat.
Pan-fry the pork belly until golden brown and crispy.
Serve with steamed vegetables of your choice.
